questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The Doctor's TARDIS looks like an old blue police box, but it is much bigger on the inside.

questions.question: In Doctor Who, which planet does the Doctor come from?
questions.explanation: The Doctor is a Time Lord from Gallifrey, while Skaro is the home planet of the Daleks.

questions.question: What colour is Blue Peter's top badge, its very highest honour?
questions.explanation: Blue Peter has been giving out its famous badges since 1963.

questions.question: On The Great British Bake Off, what title goes to the best baker each week?
questions.explanation: A handshake from Paul Hollywood is the other prize every baker hopes for.

questions.question: Which BBC show pairs celebrities with professional dancers?
questions.explanation: The winning couple lifts the glittering Glitterball trophy.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The panel try to guess which celebrity is hiding inside each costume.

questions.question: Which BBC programme has been bringing the news to children since 1972?
questions.explanation: Newsbeat is the news on Radio 1, while Newsround was made just for children.

questions.question: Which presenting pair host I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here!?
questions.explanation: Ant and Dec first met as child actors on the BBC drama Byker Grove.

questions.question: Which wildlife presenter goes looking for the world's deadliest animals on Deadly 60?
questions.explanation: Steve Backshall has tracked down sharks, snakes and spiders for the show.

questions.question: On Britain's Got Talent, what can a judge press to send an act straight through to the live shows?
questions.explanation: Gold confetti pours down when someone gets the Golden Buzzer.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The show is based on the Horrible Histories books by Terry Deary.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Wednesday Addams plays the cello and is helped by Thing, a hand with a mind of its own.

questions.question: On Gladiators, what is the name of the final race that decides who wins each show?
questions.explanation: The Wall, Duel and Powerball are all events too, but the Eliminator always comes last.

questions.question: On The Traitors, what are the players who are not Traitors called?
questions.explanation: The Faithfuls try to spot the Traitors and vote them out at the Round Table.

questions.question: On Taskmaster, who is the Taskmaster's loyal assistant?
questions.explanation: Alex Horne invented Taskmaster, and Greg Davies is the Taskmaster himself.

questions.question: Which sitcom follows the Trotter family of Peckham?
questions.explanation: Del Boy and Rodney sold dodgy goods out of a yellow three-wheeled van.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Much of Game of Thrones was filmed in Northern Ireland.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The six friends spent years on the orange sofa at the Central Perk coffee shop.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Peaky Blinders follows the Shelby family's gang in Birmingham just after the First World War.

questions.question: Which TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Downton Abbey was filmed at Highclere Castle in Hampshire.

questions.question: In which English seaside town is Fawlty Towers set?
questions.explanation: John Cleese based Basil on a rude hotel owner he met while staying in Torquay.

questions.question: Who sat beside Alexander Armstrong on Pointless from its start in 2009?
questions.explanation: Richard Osman went on to write the Thursday Murder Club novels.

questions.question: Which programme was the first ever shown on Channel 4, in November 1982?
questions.explanation: Countdown went out on the channel's opening afternoon, hosted by Richard Whiteley.

questions.question: Who became the first woman to play the Doctor in the main Doctor Who series?
questions.explanation: Jodie Whittaker became the Thirteenth Doctor at Christmas 2017, though Joanna Lumley had played a comedy Doctor for Comic Relief in 1999.

questions.question: In Line of Duty, what is the name of the anti-corruption unit?
questions.explanation: AC-12's boss Ted Hastings gave us the line 'Now we're sucking diesel'.

questions.question: In which fictional town is Coronation Street set?
questions.explanation: Walford is home to EastEnders and Holby to Casualty.

questions.question: Which TV detective's theme tune spells out his name in Morse code?
questions.explanation: Composer Barrington Pheloung tapped out M-O-R-S-E in the rhythm of the theme.

questions.question: Which Mastermind host made the line 'I've started, so I'll finish' famous?
questions.explanation: Magnus Magnusson was the first host of Mastermind, from 1972 to 1997.

questions.question: In the British version of The Office, what is the name of the paper company?
questions.explanation: Dunder Mifflin is the paper company in the American version.

questions.question: On The Chase, which quizzer is known as 'The Beast'?
questions.explanation: The other chasers have included The Dark Destroyer, The Sinnerman and The Governess.
